newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico wholesale sales rise, retail sales drop.
newsitem.headline: Mexico wholesale sales rise, retail sales drop.

text.p: Mexican retail sales dropped 3.6 percent in January compared with the same month in 1996, while wholesale sales rose 2.4 percent in the same reference period, the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) said on Thursday.

In a statement, INEGI said retail sales fell in areas such as vehicle spare parts, supermarkets, pharmacies, department stores and gasoline stations. Retail sales rose in natural gas outlets, furniture stores, vehicle outlets and ironmongers.

On the wholesale side, sales rose in industrial machinery, agriculture and services, INEGI said, while they fell in paper and books, industrial raw materials, chemical products and metallic goods, among others.

INEGI said wholesale purchases rose 5.4 percent in January compared to the same month a year earlier. The number of personnel employed in wholesale stores fell an annual 0.5 percent in January, and in retail stores the numbers slumped 5.4 percent. Pay at both wholesale and retail levels also fell.
